text: The theme-set v2 terms (Notebook spirals and sticky notes, Library typewriter and graphite, Scroll wax seals, Midnight leather and lamp pulls, and so on) are inspiration, not strict specifications; each theme's exact elements are proposed and approved per theme. Watercolor is for a different project.
rationale: Chris, 2026-10-10: these are just inspiration terms, not meant to be strict decisions.
